 Cowboys vs. Eagles | Monday, October 26, 2026 at 8:15 p.m. ET | Lincoln Financial Field, Philadelphia, PA | ESPN 
 Whenever these two teams get together, it seems like a great game is brewing. Tonight will have a bit of extra intrigue because the Eagles are so banged up. The Cowboys are healthy, but haven’t looked much better than last season. Which team will come out on top in tonight’s Monday Night Football game?
 The Cowboys come into the game with a 2-4 record for the season. They started the year with a loss to the Giants, but then they beat the Commanders with ease in Week 2. The past four weeks have been a bit rough. They lost to the Ravens, beat the Texans, then lost to the Buccaneers, and Packers in back-to-back weeks. 
 The Eagles have an identical 2-4 record, but they started the year with two wins and have lost each of the past four weeks. They started with a win over the Commanders, and then they beat the Titans. The win against Washington was good, but the win over the Titans was a bit more questionable. In the past four weeks, they lost to the Bears, Rams, Jaguars, and Panthers.
 This will be the second week that the Eagles will be playing without Jalen Hurts. Can the Cowboys take advantage of the hurting Eagles, or will Philadelphia rally behind their backups and get the victory?
